title: Effect of daily new cases of COVID-19 on public sentiment and concern: Deep learning-based sentiment classification and semantic network analysis
summary: The study used ERNIE to classify manually annotated TikTok comments across five Shanghai lockdown stages and found stage-specific themes and concerns in 1,220 comments; the classifier reached 92.6% accuracy/F1 on its reported held-out evaluation. This is a specific public-health communication result from the study sample, not a causal estimate of video impact. Two annotators reached Holsti intercoder reliability 1.0; the classifier reports accuracy/precision/recall/F1 of 92.6% on its evaluation. The observation sample is one official account during Shanghai lockdown.
ai_technology: Authors trained ERNIE on 244 manually annotated comments (110 positive, 134 negative), then applied it to the remaining 80%; semantic-network analysis followed the classifications.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: From 79 official-account videos and 1,220 comments across five CERC stages, the analysis reports stage-specific public concerns; it does not establish that videos caused those attitudes.
